articles.content_zh: 在超光谱超分辨率(HSR)中,通过单一模型实现跨传感器泛化和任意规模重建仍然是一项挑战。 虽然最近的方法支持任意规模的重建,但将其应用到训练范围以外的新传感器或尺度上,往往需要额外的数据和计算来维持重建质量. 为了应对这些挑战,我们提出OmniHSR,它预测的是波段共享的空间操作员而不是光谱值. 跨分层映射(CSM)将任何数量的波段输入重新标出到固定的参考位置,并预言有高斯支持的本地操作员. 连续操作员-实地重建(COFR)将这些操作员组成一个连续的场并应用到所有原有的波段进行任意规模重建. 实验表明,操作者预测在所有七个数据集上都超过了直接光谱值预测. 仅在ARAD上训练,只有0.538M参数, OmniHSR在没有目标域培训数据或适应的情况下,在6个看不见的数据集上直接传输的基线都超过所有绩效. 在十二个抽样系数中,从2美元到48美元,Pavia U和Chikusei的平均PSNR比最强基线提高了0.55分贝。 它还超过了从零开始训练的基线或在目标传感器上调整的基线,并实现了高达36美元/时间的更快推论。 我们的密码很快就会公布

articles.title: CoVisco: Codec-Native Vision Encoder with Native Token Compression for Unified Image-Video Understanding
articles.content: Vision-language models face a fundamental scaling bottleneck: the number of visual tokens grows with both temporal duration and spatial resolution, making long-video understanding expensive for the vision encoder and the language model. Existing methods often compress visual tokens after dense encoding, creating a mismatch between the representation used during training and the compact interface required at deployment. We present CoVisco, a codec-native vision encoder with native token compression for unified image-video understanding. By combining codec-native input support with segmented attention, CoVisco can encode long visual inputs in a single forward pass without forming dense patch-to-patch interactions across all frames. Each temporal segment is equipped with learnable abstract tokens that learn a compact segment-level representation, while fine-grained patch tokens remain available throughout the encoder. Alternating intra-segment and abstract-communication layers preserve video-level context through the abstract-token channel. A lightweight selector further exposes either abstract tokens alone or abstract tokens augmented with a runtime-selected subset of patch tokens, yielding a compact visual interface that reduces the visual context and prefill burden of downstream MLLMs while retaining fine-grained evidence when needed. Pretrained with contrastive objectives on 565M image--text pairs and 6.4M videos, CoVisco shows competitive performance on video-oriented embedding and multimodal understanding benchmarks. In the evaluated four-segment, 64-frame setting, abstract-only inference uses only 400 visual tokens while achieving video-understanding performance close to, and on some benchmarks exceeding, OneVision-Encoder. Selected patch tokens further improve fine-grained video reasoning. Project URL: https://github.com/ernie-research/CoVisco.git
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: CoVisco: 编码- 内生视觉编码器, 并使用原生Token压缩来统一图像- 视频理解
articles.content_zh: 视觉语言模型面临一个根本性的缩放瓶颈:视觉符号的数量随着时间长度和空间分辨率同时增长,使得长视频理解对视觉编码器和语言模型来说代价高昂. 现有方法往往会压缩密集编码后的视觉符号,造成训练期间使用的表示和部署时所需的紧凑接口不匹配. 我们介绍CoVisco,一个编码器 内生视觉编码器, 本地的符号压缩, 统一图像-视频理解。 CoVisco通过将编码-内生输入支持和分出注意力相结合,可以在单个前行通道中编码长视输入,而不会在所有帧内形成密集的补丁相接互动. 每个时间段都配有可学习的抽象符号来学习紧凑的分层层代表,而精细的分层补丁符号则在整个编码器中仍然可用. 将内部分层和抽象-通信层通过抽象-token通道来保存视频级上下文. 轻量级的选取器进一步暴露出单独抽象的指使或以运行时所选择的补丁指使子集来扩充的抽象指使,产生一个紧凑的视觉界面来减少下游MLLM的视觉上下文和预填负担,同时在需要时保留精细的证据. CoVisco在565M图像文本配对和6.4M视频上进行了具有对比性目标的预先培训,在面向视频的嵌入和多模式理解基准上展现了竞争性表现。 在被评价的"四分法"中,64帧设定,只抽象地推论只使用400个可视化符号,同时实现视频理解性能接近并在某些基准上超过"One Vision-Encoder". 所选择的补丁符号会进一步改善精细的视频推理. 项目 URL: https://github.com/ernie-research/CoVisco.git 互联网档案馆的存檔,存档日期2013-12-22.

articles.title: MCD: Causal Distillation of Multimodal In-Context Learning in Large Vision-Language Models
articles.content: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) exhibit strong multimodal in-context learning (ICL) capabilities, yet this ability degrades substantially as model size decreases. Knowledge distillation offers a natural way to bridge this gap, but existing methods primarily align output distributions or hidden representations directly. Such alignment teaches the student what the teacher predicts without revealing which evidence in the complex context causally supports that prediction. Consequently, a student can imitate the teacher's answer while continuing to rely on language priors, prompt structure, or other spurious cues. To address this limitation, we introduce Multimodal Causal Distillation (MCD), a distillation framework that transfers how a strong teacher uses multimodal evidence during ICL. MCD uses structure-preserving token interventions to identify and verify causal evidence, then transfers how the teacher responds when that evidence is retained or removed. This design connects distillation to the causal patterns by which the model uses contextual evidence during multimodal ICL. Experiments across three LVLM families and seven benchmarks show that MCD improves student performance by 7.23 points on average and outperforms vanilla distillation by 4.68 points, while further analyses confirm the generalizability of these gains.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: MCD:大型远景-语言模型中多式联运内容学习的因果扭曲
articles.content_zh: 大型视觉语言模型(LVLMs)显示出强大的多模式内文学习能力,但随着模型尺寸的缩小,这种能力会大幅度地下降。 知识分馏提供了弥补这一差距的自然途径,但现有方法主要直接调整出产分布或隐藏表达. 这种校正让学生了解老师的预测,而不披露复杂背景中哪些证据可因果地支持这种预测。 因此,学生可以模仿教师的回答,同时继续依赖语言前科、即时结构或其他虚假提示。 为了消除这一局限性,我们引入了多式因子蒸馏法(MCD),这是一种分馏框架,它转移了强师在《国际商业法》期间如何使用多式证据。 MCD使用结构保存符号干预来识别并核实因果关系,然后转移教师在证据被保留或删除时的反应方式. 这种设计将蒸馏与模型在多式ICL中使用上下文证据的因果模式相连接. 3个LVLM家庭和7个基准的实验表明,MCD平均提高学生成绩7.23分,超过香草蒸馏4.68分,而进一步的分析则证实这些成绩是普遍的.

articles.title: NavHarness: Adaptive Goals for Agentic Vision-Language Navigation
articles.content: Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) requires embodied agents to generate actions based on instructions and observations. General-purpose multimodal agents offer a promising basis for this task, but selecting plausible local actions does not ensure that execution remains consistent with the intended route, particularly in long-horizon tasks. Moreover, the accumulated interaction history increases the input required for subsequent decisions, resulting in a significant inference overhead. To this end, we introduce \method, an Agentic VLN framework that includes a Goal Agent that sets adaptive goals for local actions, a Verify Agent that dynamically verifies whether a goal has been completed, a Memory Agent for multimodal context compression, and a Visuomotor Agent to execute adaptive goals. Specifically, the Goal Agent formulates adaptive goals based on the instruction, current observation, and execution history. Then the Visuomotor Agent executes navigation actions to achieve each goal, while the Verify Agent uses a goal-specific verification question to dynamically assess whether the observed outcomes satisfy the intended completion condition. Verified goal completion then marks a boundary for the Memory Agent to compress the corresponding multimodal interaction history while preserving information needed for subsequent navigation. We evaluate navigation on R2R-CE and RxR-CE, examine framework variants across three model backbones, and study context evolution during execution. For Real-World evaluation, \method achieves 83.3\% success and 1.51\,m navigation error across eight challenging routes evaluated three times each.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: NavHarness: 代理视野-语言导航的可适应目标
articles.content_zh: 远景-语言导航(VLN)要求包含的代理以指示和观察为基础产生行动. 通用多式联运代理人为这项任务提供了有希望的基础,但选择可行的当地行动并不能确保执行工作与预期路线保持一致,特别是在长期任务中。 此外,累积的互动历史增加了后续决定所需的投入,导致大量推断间接费用。 为此,我们引入了\方法,这是一个代理性VLN框架,其中包括一个目标代理为当地行动设定适应性目标,一个能够动态核实一个目标是否完成的验证代理,一个用于多模式环境压缩的记忆代理,以及一个用于执行适应性目标的Visumotor代理. 具体来说,目标代理人根据指示、当前观察和执行历史制定适应性目标。 然后,Visumotor Agent执行导航动作来达到每个目标,而校验Agent则使用一个针对特定目标的核查问题来动态地评估所观察到的结果是否符合预定的完成条件. 验证目标完成后为内存代理公司标出一个边界来压缩相应的多模式交互历史,同时保存后续导航所需的信息. 我们评价R2R-CE和RxR-CE的导航,审查三个模型骨干之间的框架变体,研究执行过程中的背景演变. 对于Real-World评价,\方法实现83.3+X成功和1.51\,m 跨越8条挑战性航道的导航出错,每条航道评估三次.

articles.title: Learning Where to Look: Anatomical Grounding and Guided Attention for Cardiac MRI Vision-Language Models
articles.content: Cardiac magnetic resonance imaging (CMR) enables assessment of cardiac anatomy, ventricular function, and myocardial tissue characteristics. Clinicians interpret these images by identifying cardiac structures and focusing on the regions relevant to each clinical question, motivating anatomically guided vision-language models (VLMs). Yet CMR-specific supervision for anatomical localisation and clinical question answering remains limited. To address this gap, we investigate fine-grained CMR visual question answering through anatomical grounding and guided attention. We construct 128,915 anatomical-grounding and 42,799 clinical QA pairs across short-axis cine, late gadolinium enhancement, and long-axis cine. These datasets support anatomical recognition, localisation, and clinical assessment without requiring paired reports for individual training images. To help the model learn where to look, we introduce Cardiac Anatomy-Routed Attention (CARA), which selects predicted anatomical priors according to the question and guides decoder attention with learned task-specific strengths. Combining anatomical grounding pretraining with CARA yields our model, CARA-VL. Experiments demonstrate CARA-VL's strengths in clinical assessment and regional localisation across CMR imaging settings, with promising generalization to an external clinical cohort. Together, our data and method provide a practical framework for studying and advancing cardiac visual understanding in VLMs. We will release the QA data derived from public datasets upon publication.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 学习向何处看:心脏核磁共振视-语言模型的解剖定位和引导注意
articles.content_zh: 心地磁共振成像(CMR)能够对心地解剖学,通心功能,心肌组织特征进行评估. 临床医生通过识别心脏结构并关注与每个临床问题相关的区域来解释这些图像,激发解剖引导的视觉语言模型(VLMs). 然而,对解剖定位和临床问题回答的《集束弹药公约》具体监督仍然有限。 为了弥补这一差距,我们调查了通过解剖地基和引导注意力来回答遗留集束弹药问题的详细视觉问题。 我们建造了128,915个解剖地基和42,799个临床QA对,跨越了短轴焚化,后期加多利nium增强和长轴焚化. 这些数据集支持解剖识别,本地化和临床评估,而不需要单个培训图像的配对报告. 为了帮助模型学习看哪里,我们引入了心地解剖学-Routed Content(CARA),它根据问题选择预测解剖学前科,并用学到的任务特异性优势指导解码器的注意. 结合解剖基础 预训与CARA 产生我们的模型,CARA -VL。 实验表明,CARA-VL在对遗留集束弹药成像环境进行临床评估和区域定位方面具有优势,对外部临床人群的概括很有希望。 我们的数据和方法共同提供了一个实用的框架,用于研究和推进对心电图的视觉理解。 我们将公布从公共数据集获得的质量保证数据。

articles.title: Spatial-Temporal Multi-scale Network for Screen Content Video Quality Enhancement
articles.content: Different from natural videos, Screen Content Videos (SCVs) are characterized by abrupt motion, scene switches, and high-frequency details such as text and graphics. Conventional video enhancement methods, which rely heavily on temporal continuity, often suffer from performance degradation when processing SCVs due to the disruption of temporal correlations. To address these challenges, we propose the Spatial-Temporal Multi-scale Network (STM-Net), a novel framework specifically tailored for compressed SCV enhancement. Our approach integrates three complementary components: a Prior-Guided Spatio-Temporal Dispatcher (PG-STD) that routes input into three parallel streams to avoid feature contamination, a Bidirectional Temporal Feature Extraction (BTFE) module that adaptively handles abrupt transitions without explicit detection, and a Cascaded Multi-scale Feature Distillation (CMFD) module that preserves critical high-frequency details. Experimental results demonstrate that STM-Net outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both objective metrics and subjective visual quality, providing a robust solution for screen content artifacts. Code is available at https://github.com/HUANGZiyin1/STM-Net.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 屏幕内容多尺度网络视频质量提升
articles.content_zh: 与自然视频不同的是,屏幕内容视频(SCV)的特点是突然移动,场景开关,以及文字和图形等高频细节. 常规视频增强方法严重依赖时间连续性,由于时间相关性的中断,在处理SCV时往往会出现性能退化. 为了应对这些挑战,我们提议建立空间-时空多尺度网络(STM-Net),这是一个专门针对压缩SCV增强的新框架。 我们的方法包括三个相辅相成的组成部分:一个事先指导的Spatio-Temporal调度器(PG-STD),它引导输入到三个平行流来避免地貌污染;一个双向的Temperal Feature Industructionon(BTFE)模块,它适应性地处理突发的过渡而没有明确检测;以及一个Cascaded多尺度的地貌分化模块,它保存了关键的高频细节。 实验结果显示,STM-Net在客观度量和主观视觉质量上都优于最先进的方法,为屏幕内容文物提供了有力的解决方案. 代码见https://github.com/HUANGZiyin1/STM-Net.

articles.title: Grounding with Confidence: Controllable Generative Video Temporal Grounding
articles.content: Video temporal grounding supports applications such as video search, content review, and automated editing by localizing events described in natural language. Yet existing generative models typically output timestamps without explicit interval-level confidence scores to guide candidate selection. We separate candidate generation from acceptance by scoring individual intervals within the original decoding pass. A lightweight confidence head reads pooled decoder states, providing an explicit score trained for interval selection. Offline verifier scores supervise the head on fixed candidate sequences, and temporal-overlap labels adapt it to current rollouts during reinforcement learning. GT-anchored candidate-pool supervision and set-level optimization train the generator. The resulting scores support ranking, threshold-based selection, and rejection without invoking an external verifier at inference. On a fixed OMTG-Bench candidate pool, confidence raises query-macro Recall@0.5 from 9.95% to 14.42% over generation order at a 10% global return budget, and from 26.48% to 31.12% at a 25% budget. The continuous scores let downstream applications adjust return budgets or acceptance thresholds to match their precision-recall preferences, without regenerating candidate intervals.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 自信地打地平线:可控地平线视频时间打地平线
articles.content_zh: 视频时间定位支持视频搜索,内容审查等应用,并通过将自然语言描述的事件本地化来自动编辑. 然而,现有的基因模型通常输出时间戳,没有明确的间隔级信任分来指导候选人的甄选。 我们把候选人一代与接受者分开,在最初的解码通行证内给个人间隔打分。 轻量级置信头读取集合解码器状态,为间隔选择提供经过培训的明确分数. 离线核查员的分数在固定候选序列上监督头部,时间重叠的标签在强化学习期间使其适应目前的推出. GT选手-集合监督及设置级优化培训发电机. 由此产生的分数支持排名,基于阈值的选取,以及拒绝,而无需在推论中引用外部核实者. 在固定的OMTG-Bench候选人才库中,信心将查询-宏观召回@0.5从9.95%提高到14.42%,按10%的全球回报预算计算,从26.48%提高到31.12%,按25%的预算计算。 连续的分数让下游应用程序调整回程预算或接受阈值,以与其精准的回召偏好相匹配,而无需再生成候选间隔.

articles.title: Hyperspectral Image Models: Technical Report
articles.content: Hyperspectral remote sensing has advanced across diverse deep learning paradigms, including spectral spatial CNNs, Vision Transformers, Mamba, graph neural networks, Kolmogorov Arnold networks, and self supervised masked autoencoding. Yet progress remains hindered by fragmented repositories, incompatible tensor conventions, and non standardized evaluation. Hyperspectral Image Models addresses these challenges through a modular framework unifying 55 representative models across six paradigms with a common registry, automatic 4D/5D tensor adaptation, and standardized constructors. It integrates 24 benchmark scenes from Airborne, Spaceborne, UAV, and Mars CRISM sensors, with caching, label remapping, PCA, explicit band selection or raw spectra, optional spatial max pooling, and arbitrary PxP patch extraction. To prevent inflated accuracy from overlapping windows, it supports class balanced random partitioning and spatially disjoint regional blocking with Chebyshev guard bands that eliminate train test pixel overlap. Experiments use a single config.yaml with deterministic seeds and complete provenance, generating LaTeX benchmark tables and classification maps. Across 1,320 model scene evaluations and 6,600 seeded runs, scene difficulty dominates architecture, with mean accuracy ranging from 96.40% on Botswana to 56.70% on Houston 2018, versus a 15 point spread across paradigm means. No paradigm universally dominates, while sub 1 M parameter models can match architectures two orders of magnitude larger. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/Tanishq251/Hyperspectral-Image-Models.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 超光谱 图像模型:技术报告
articles.content_zh: 超光谱遥感跨越了各种深层学习范式,包括光谱空间CNN,Vision Transformers,Mamba,图神经网络,Kolmogorov Arnold网络,以及自我监督的蒙面自编码. 然而,分散的储存库、不兼容的抗辐射公约以及非标准化评价仍然阻碍着进展。 超光谱 图像模型通过一个模块化框架来应对这些挑战,该框架将55个代表性模型统一到6个范式中,并配有共同的登记册、自动4D/5D收音机和标准化的构造器。 它将空降、空降、无人驾驶飞行器和火星CRISM传感器的24个基准场景集成在一起,包括缓冲、标签再映射、PCA、明确的波段选择或原始光谱、可选空间最大集合以及任意的PxP补丁提取等。 为防止由相重叠的窗口产生夸大精度,它支持类平衡随机分出并空间上与Chebyshev守护带脱节的区域阻隔,从而消除了列车测试像素相重叠. 实验使用单一的config.yaml并有决定种子和完整的出处,生成了LaTeX基准表和分类图. 在1,320个模型场景评价和6,600个种子跑道上,场景难度主导了建筑,平均准确度从博茨瓦纳的96.40%到2018年休斯敦的56.70%不等,而15分分布在范式手段之间. 没有范式普遍占据主导地位,而子 1 M 参数模型可以匹配两个更大的数量级架构. 代码在https://github.com/Tanishq251/Hyper光谱-Image-Models上公开.

articles.title: DyRAD: Radar Novel View Synthesis for Dynamic Driving Scenes
articles.content: Reconstructing dynamic driving scenes from recorded sensor data supports closed-loop evaluation of autonomous driving systems by synthesizing observations beyond the original trajectory. Unlike cameras and LiDAR, radar measures radial velocity directly through Doppler. Yet existing radar novel-view synthesis fails to exploit this capability: methods addressing dynamic scenes reconstruct only range-azimuth tensors, while methods that render Doppler assume static scenes. Moreover, because radar processing spreads each reflection across multiple bins, existing representations absorb this spread into scene geometry, causing it to render incorrectly when the viewpoint moves. We present DyRAD, which models dynamic driving scenes using static background reflectors and motion-tracked dynamic point reflectors to render complete range-azimuth-Doppler (RAD) tensors. Reflector velocities are derived from object tracks and projected onto the line of sight, making Doppler both a rendered output and supervision for those tracks. Crucially, we render reflectors through a fixed analytic point-spread function (PSF) derived from the radar's signal-processing chain, preventing sensor-induced spread from being baked into the scene representation. Beyond improving scene reconstruction, this separation also enables zero-shot sensor-configuration transfer, allowing the same reconstructed scene to be rendered under different radar specifications without refitting. We evaluate DyRAD on RADIal, Boreas, and a synthetic benchmark across both on-path poses and displaced viewpoints untested by prior work. On RADIal, DyRAD recovers radar detections in 90.7% of reference-detected objects, compared with 26.9% for the strongest baseline.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: DyRAD: 动态驱动场景的雷达小说视图合成
articles.content_zh: 从所记录的传感器数据中重建动态驱动场景,通过合成超出原始轨迹的观测结果,支持对自主驱动系统的闭路评价. 与相机和LiDAR不同,雷达直接通过多普勒测量射线速度. 然而,现有的雷达小说-视觉合成未能利用这种能力:处理动态场景的方法只重建了射程-分量活度计,而使多普勒承担静态场景的方法. 此外,由于雷达处理将每个反射分散在多个相机箱中,现有的表示法吸收了这种被传播到场景几何中,导致视线移动时产生不正确. 我们介绍DyRAD,它使用静态背景反射器和运动跟踪动态点反射器来模拟动态驱动场景,以制取完整的测距-azimuth-多普勒(RAD)测距器. 反射速度取自于物体轨道并投射到视线上,使多普勒既成了这些轨道的输出也成为了监督. 关键的是,我们通过雷达信号处理链产生的固定分析点散函数(PSF)来制取反射器,防止由传感器引起的扩散被烤入场景代表. 除了改善场景重建外,这种分离还使得零发感应-配置能转移,使得同样的被重建的场景可以在不同的雷达规格下进行渲染而无需重新配置. 我们对RADIal、Boreas的DyRAD进行了评估,并用一个合成基准衡量横跨路径上和转移的观点,但没有经过先前的工作检验。 在RADIal上,DyRAD在90.7%的参考探测物体中恢复了雷达探测,而最强基线为26.9%.

articles.title: Spherical Interpolation for Backward-Compatible Multimodal Representations
articles.content: Contrastive vision-language models map visual and textual representations into a shared normalized embedding space, making cosine similarity the natural metric for cross-modal retrieval. A practical challenge arises during model upgrades: independently trained models generally produce incompatible representation spaces, so replacing a deployed model typically requires recomputing embeddings for the entire gallery, which is prohibitively expensive at scale. Orthogonal post-hoc alignment can partially mitigate this problem by mapping new-model queries into the old-model gallery space. However, because independently trained models can differ in fine-grained representation structure, the orthogonal alignment remains approximate, leaving a residual angular discrepancy between the old-model query and the aligned new-model query. We study whether interpolation along the spherical geodesic between these two normalized query representations can improve retrieval without re-indexing the gallery. We characterize when this path contains an interior query direction closer to an idealized retrieval-optimal direction than either endpoint, and connect this characterization to Recall@$K$ through a local margin-based certification result. Experiments across multiple benchmarks and model families show that post-alignment spherical interpolation improves over orthogonal alignment alone, recovering backward-compatibility in most evaluated settings. Consistent with our geometric characterization, per-query oracle analysis shows that retrieval-favorable interior points occur frequently in practice. Code is available at https://github.com/miccunifi/SLERP_backward_compatibility .
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 向后兼容多式代表的球形内插
articles.content_zh: 相矛盾的视觉语言模型将视觉和文字表现映射成一个共享的正态嵌入空间,使同位素相似性成为跨模式检索的自然度量. 在模型升级过程中出现了一个实际挑战:独立训练的模型一般会产生不相容的表示空间,因此替换一个被部署的模型通常需要对整个画廊进行回配嵌入,在规模上是极其昂贵的. 通过将新模式的查询映射到旧模式的画廊空间中,对地对地热后对接可以部分缓解这个问题. 然而,由于经过独立训练的模型在精细的表达结构上可能有所不同,正交对接仍然大致相同,留下了旧模型查询和相适应的新模型查询之间的剩余角差. 我们研究这两个正常的查询表示之间的球形大地测量的插值是否能改善检索,而无需重新索引画廊。 当此路径包含一个更接近理想化检索-最佳取向的内置查询方向时,我们描述,并通过基于本地边距的认证结果将这一特性与Recall@$K$相连接。 跨越多个基准和模式家族的实验表明,后调整球形插值单靠正向调整就能改善,在大多数评价环境中恢复后向相容性. 与我们的几何特征一致的是,每克甲骨文分析表明,在实践中经常出现可检索的内分点。 代码见https://github.com/miccunifi/SLERP_backward_compatibility.

articles.title: P-SRM: Selective Recovery of Rejected Predictions in Visual Tracking
articles.content: Many visual tracking methods use rejection mechanisms to suppress unreliable predictions. However, these mechanisms can also reject correctly localized candidates, leaving useful information unused. We investigate how to identify and recover these candidates while preserving native accepted outputs and candidate coordinates. To this end, we propose P-SRM (Post-rejection Selective Recovery Method), which combines spatial responses, past accepted states, and native decision margins to reassess candidates and selectively restore reliable predictions. We evaluate P-SRM on six trackers and four datasets spanning category-specific, point, and generic object tracking. Across all nine configurations, P-SRM improves rejected-candidate ranking and overall tracking performance. These results show that post-rejection verification can identify and recover useful predictions discarded by native rejection, demonstrating the value of reusing rejected information. Project repository: https://github.com/PalestyHR/P-SRM.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: P-SRM:在视觉跟踪中选择性地恢复拒绝的预测
articles.content_zh: 许多视觉跟踪方法使用拒绝机制来压制不可靠的预测. 然而,这些机制也可以正确拒绝本地化候选人,使有用的信息得不到利用。 我们调查如何确定和收回这些候选人,同时保留当地接受的产出和候选人的坐标。 为此,我们提出P-SRM(后拒绝选择恢复方法),该方法将空间反应、过去接受的状态和本土决定幅度结合起来,重新评估候选人并有选择地恢复可靠的预测。 我们通过6个跟踪器和4个数据集评估P-SRM,它们跨越特定类别、点和通用对象跟踪。 在所有9个配置中,P-SRM改进了被否决的candidate排名和总体跟踪性能. 这些结果显示,拒绝后核查可以识别并恢复被本土拒绝所丢弃的有用预测,表明重新使用被拒绝信息的价值. 项目存放处:https://github.com/PalestyHR/P-SRM.

articles.title: Inline Memory Meets Reusable Skills: Memory-centric Framework for Vision-Language-Action Model
articles.content: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown strong promise for general-purpose robotic manipulation, yet adapting them to new tasks and domains remains inefficient: existing methods often rely on parameter tuning, incurring substantial costs and risking catastrophic forgetting of previously learned tasks. To address this, we propose \textbf{Optimus-R}, a memory-centric VLA framework that formulates robotic adaptation as explicit query-skill memory tuning. Optimus-R introduces: (i) An \textbf{Inline Memory Interface for skill extraction}. It inserts learnable memory tokens into the VLA prefix stream, allowing the backbone to derive control-aware query and skill representations within the native action-conditioning pathway. (ii) A \textbf{Query-Skill Memory Bank for skill learning}. It externalizes skills into query prototypes for deciding \emph{what} to retrieve and skill values for specifying \emph{how} to act, supporting skill reuse and expansion with limited parameter updates. (iii) A lightweight \textbf{Bridge-and-Adapt mechanism for skill updating}. It aligns target-domain queries and skills with the existing memory space through a lightweight adapter and residual memory updates. Experiments on in-domain adaptation, cross-domain adaptation, and lifelong learning show that Optimus-R enables data-efficient skill learning while mitigating catastrophic forgetting.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 内置内存 可再利用的技能:愿景-语言-行动模式的以记忆为中心的框架
articles.content_zh: 愿景-语言-行动模型对通用机器人操纵表现出了很强的希望,但使其适应新的任务和领域仍然效率不高:现有方法往往依赖于参数调整,付出了巨大的成本并有可能灾难性地忘记以前学到的任务。 为了解决这个问题,我们提议\textbf{Optimus-R},一个以记忆为中心的VLA框架,它将机器人适应作为明确的查询技能内存调取. Optimus-R介绍:(一)\textbf{用于技能提取的内存接口}。 它将可学习的内存符号插入到VLA前缀流中,使骨干在原生的动作调节路径中可以得出可控意识的查询和技能表示. (二) 用于技能学习的\textbf{Query-技能记忆库]。 它将技能外部化为查询原型,用于决定\emph{什么}检索和指定\emph{how}动作的技能值,支持技能再用,并使用有限的参数更新来扩展. (三) 轻量级\ textbf{ Bridge-and-Adapt 机制用于技能更新}。 它通过轻量级适配器和剩余内存更新,将目标域查询和技能与现有的内存空间相协调. 关于域内适应、跨域适应和终身学习的实验表明,Optimus-R能够使数据效率高的技能学习同时减轻灾难性的遗忘。

articles.title: Seeing as Humans Do: Learning from Motion to Segment Anything Without Supervision
articles.content: The Segment Anything Model (SAM) relies heavily on massive manual annotations, creating a fundamental bottleneck for model scaling. While unsupervised methods attempt to learn object concepts from motion, they typically overfit to moving entities, lacking both multi-granularity understanding and the ability to generalize to static objects. To overcome this, we introduce Motion-Grounded Segment Anything (MoSA), a highly scalable unsupervised framework that learns a transferable objectness prior from unlabeled videos. MoSA operates in three progressive stages: (1) automatically generating multi-granularity motion pseudo-labels from large-scale video data; (2) training a Perceptual Grouping Model (PGM) via contrastive learning to internalize a generalized, appearance-driven concept of objects; and (3) transferring this learned prior into a prompt-guided architecture for segment-anything-style inference on images. Extensive zero-shot evaluations across seven challenging benchmarks (e.g., COCO and ADE20K) demonstrate that MoSA significantly outperforms existing unsupervised methods. Notably, despite using zero manual annotations, MoSA achieves segmentation performance comparable to the fully supervised SAM. Our findings reveal that harnessing large-scale unlabeled motion is a feasible and highly scalable alternative to annotation-driven segment-anything pipelines.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 视为人类 做: 从动议学习到无监督的分区
articles.content_zh: 片段"Anything Model"(SAM)严重依赖大规模人工说明,为模型的缩放制造了根本性的瓶颈. 虽然无人监督的方法试图从运动中学习物体概念,但它们通常过于适合移动实体,既缺乏多角度的理解,也缺乏通向静态物体的能力. 为了克服这种情况,我们引入了Motion-Grounded Special Anything(MoSA),这是一个高度可扩展的无监督框架,它从无标签的视频中学习到一个可转移的对象。 MOSA在三个进步阶段运作:(1)从大型视频数据中自动生成多光度运动伪标签;(2)通过对比性学习来培训一种感知类群模型(PGM)来将一个通用的,外观驱动的物体概念内化;(3)将之前学到的这个概念转移到一个快速导引的架构中,用于对图像的分块式推论. 对7个具有挑战性的基准(如COCO和ADE20K)进行广泛的零镜头评价表明,该部的绩效大大超过现有的不受监督的方法。 值得注意的是,尽管使用了零手动说明,MOSA还是实现了与完全监督的SAM相类似的分解性能. 我们的调查结果表明,利用大规模无标签运动是可行的和高度可扩展的替代注解驱动的区段-任何管道。

articles.title: Revisiting On-policy Adversarial Black-Box Distillation: Calibrating Groupwise Reward Geometry for Effective Advantage Construction
articles.content: Black-box distillation is a practical route for transferring capabilities from API-accessible large language models that expose only text outputs into smaller student models. Recent on-policy adversarial methods such as GAD improve over SeqKD by forming an adversarial loop between a critic and a student, where the critic provides rewards for GRPO-based student policy optimization over the student's sampled responses. However, GRPO computes advantages from the within-group relative rewards of student samples for the same prompt, whereas the critic is trained primarily to distinguish teacher responses from student responses. This objective mismatch can produce reward groups with collapsed scale or fragile margins, leading to brittle grouped optimization signals. We propose Groupwise Reward Geometry Conditioning (GRGC), a two-stage framework that improves advantage construction by shaping student-side reward groups during both critic training and policy optimization. To improve critic-side conditioning, Gaussian groupwise Optimal Transport calibration regularizes the critic during training to produce reward groups with non-collapsed spread and smooth rank-wise gaps by matching sorted prompt-wise rewards to group-centered Gaussian quantiles. Building on this conditioned reward geometry, policy-side group power modulation reshapes the prompt-wise reward groups before they are converted into advantages, preserving the critic-induced ordering while increasing optimization-relevant margin separability. Extensive experiments across diverse teachers, student model families and scales, and training datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of GRGC on both in-distribution and out-of-distribution evaluations, while introducing negligible overhead over GAD. The code is available at https://github.com/2018cx/GRGC.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 重审政策上反面的"黑-牛"稀释:校正集团 奖励几何以有效优势建设
articles.content_zh: 黑盒蒸馏是从API可访问的大型语言模型中转移能力的一种实用途径,这些模型只将文本输出暴露在较小的学生模型中. 最近的政策对抗方法如GAD比SeqKD有所改进,在评论家和学生之间形成对抗循环,评论家对基于GRPO的学生政策优化给予奖励,而不是学生的抽样反应. 然而,GRPO从学生样本的团体内部相对奖励中计算出优势,而批评者的培训主要是区分教师的反应和学生的反应。 这种客观不匹配可产生规模倒塌或边际脆弱的奖励团体,从而导致被组合成组的优化信号。 我们提议采用集团奖励几何条件(GRGC)这一两阶段框架,通过在批评者培训和政策优化期间塑造学生奖励团体来改进优势建设。 为了改善批评者-侧面条件,高斯智集团优化交通校正在训练期间对批评者进行规范化,通过将分级快速奖励与以高斯智集团为核心的方块相匹配,产生奖赏团体并有不折不扣的分布和平滑的分级差距. 以这种有条件的奖励几何学为基础,政策-侧方群动力调制在转换为优势之前重新塑造了即时奖励组,保留了评论家引起的命令,同时增加了与优化相关的比分分. 各种教师、学生模范家庭和规模的广泛实验以及培训数据集表明,GRGC在分配和分配评价方面都取得了成效,同时对性别与发展提出了微不足道的间接费用。 该代码可在https://github.com/2018cx/GRGC上查阅.

articles.title: Determining Vertical Displacement of Agricultural Areas Using UAV-Photogrammetry and a Heteroscedastic Deep Learning Model
articles.content: This article introduces an algorithm that uses a U-Net architecture to determine vertical ground surface displacements from unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV)-photogrammetry point clouds, offering an alternative to traditional ground filtering methods. Unlike con-ventional ground filters that rely on point cloud classification, the proposed approach em-ploys heteroscedastic regression. The U-Net model predicts the conditional expected val-ues of the elevation corrections, aiming to reduce the impact of vegetation on determined ground surface elevations. Concurrently, it estimates the logarithm of the elevation cor-rection variance, allowing for direct quantification of the uncertainty associated with each elevation correction value. The algorithm was evaluated using three metrics: the root mean square error (RMSE) of vertical displacements, the percentage of nodes with deter-mined displacement values, and the percentage of outliers among those values. Perfor-mance was assessed using the technique for order of preference by similarity to ideal so-lution (TOPSIS) method and compared against several ground-filter-based algorithms across four datasets, each including at least two time intervals. In most cases, the U-Net-based approach demonstrated a slight performance advantage over traditional ground filtering techniques. For example, for the U-Net-based algorithm, for one of the test da-tasets, the RMSE of the determined subsidences was 6.1 cm, the percentage of nodes with determined subsidences was 80.5%, and the percentage of outliers was 0.2%. For the same case, the algorithm based on the next best model (SMRF) allowed an RMSE of 7.7 cm to be obtained; for 77.3% of nodes, the subsidences were determined; and the percentage of outliers was 0.3%.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 利用无人驾驶飞行器-摄影测量和异形深层学习模型确定农业地区的纵向迁移
articles.content_zh: 文章引入了使用U-Net架构的算法,以确定从无人驾驶航空飞行器(UAV)-相位测量点云中垂直地表位置,为传统地上过滤方法提供了一种替代. 与依赖点云分级的平地滤波器不同,所拟议的方法会使异性回向. U-Net模型预测了海拔校正的有条件预期值,目的是减少植被对确定的地表海拔的影响。 同时,它还估算了高地相撞差的对数,从而可以直接量化与每个高地校正值有关的不确定性。 该算法使用三个衡量标准进行了评估:垂直移位的根正方形差错(RMSE),有阻断偏移值的节点的百分比,以及这些值中值外值的百分比。 通过与理想的等离子(TOPSIS)方法的相近性来评估Perfor-mance,并与跨越四个数据集的几个地膜算法进行比较,每个数据集至少包括两个时间间隔. 在大多数情况下,基于U-Net的方法显示出比传统的地面过滤技术稍有性能优势。 例如,对于基于U-Net的算法,对于其中一个测试da-tasets,确定下沉的RMSE为6.1cm,确定下沉的节点百分比为80.5%,出站百分比为0.2%. 对于同一种情况,基于下等最佳模型(SMRF)的算法允许获得7.7厘米的RMSE;对于77.3%的节点,下等分数被确定;出等分数的百分比为0.3%.

articles.title: FAST: Flow Any Scene Transformer
articles.content: Scaling has become a primary driver of progress in language and vision foundation models, yet its role in precise correspondence matching remains underexplored. In this work, we present Flow Any Scene Transformer (FAST), a scalable correspondence model driven by two key insights. First, we reveal that the query-key projections inside single-view vision foundation models encode a coarse yet reusable prior for cross-view matching. Second, reusing these pretrained projections in cross-attention form yields a highly effective initialization for a ViT-based matcher built from a single-view encoder. Guided by these insights, we build FAST upon a vanilla single-view foundation model, utilizing a zero-parameter rewiring strategy to convert selected self-attention layers into cross-attention for cross-view interaction. This design allows ViT-based matchers to scale with advances in single-view foundation models, bypassing the need for a dedicated pair-centric pretraining stage. To fully unlock the scaling potential of this formulation, we assemble a 6-million-pair training corpus for general-purpose dense 2D displacement estimation across diverse co-visible image pairs. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FAST achieves state-of-the-art performance across a wide range of benchmarks, while scaling favorably with both backbone size and training data.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: FAST: 任意场景变换器
articles.content_zh: 扩大规模已成为语言和愿景基础模式取得进展的主要驱动力,但其在精确通信匹配方面的作用仍然没有得到充分利用。 在这部作品中,我们提出了"Flow Any Scene Transformer"(FAST),这是一种由两个关键见解所驱动的可伸缩的函证模型. 首先,我们揭示,单视视野基础模型中的查询键预测编码为粗糙而可再用,用于交叉视图匹配。 第二,以交叉意向形式重新使用这些事先经过训练的预测,对于由单视编码器所建造的基于ViT的匹配器,会产生非常有效的初始化. 以这些见解为指导,我们以香草单景基模型为基础构建了FAST,使用零参数重接策略,将所选自意层转换为跨景交互. 这种设计使得基于ViT的配对者能够以单视基础模型的进步来进行规模化,绕过对一对以双心为主的预训阶段的需求. 为了充分释放这种配方的分级潜力,我们收集了600万帕的培训用具,用于对各种可共见图像对的二维密度迁移情况进行通用估计。 广泛的实验表明,FAST在广泛的基准中取得了最先进的业绩,同时以主干规模和培训数据进行有利的推广。

articles.title: Let the Carrier Carry the Attack: Preserving the Subject in Adversarial Image Generation
articles.content: Strong unrestricted adversarial attacks can distort the primary object of an image, hereafter referred to as the subject. To preserve subject integrity without compromising attack magnitude, we introduce the carrier: a secondary visual element that provides an auxiliary region to facilitate the attack under global classifier guidance. We demonstrate three key findings: 1. A carrier mitigates subject distortion by absorbing a larger share of globally normalized attack updates. 2. A carrier improves cross-model transferability, governed by the strength of target-related features that balance semantic separation and transfer performance. 3. Successful targeted attacks retain the personalized subject as the primary content perceived by humans while successfully misleading the classifier. Our results demonstrate that a visually secondary carrier offers an auxiliary spatial pathway for adversarial changes, enabling strong and transferable attacks while improving subject preservation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 让载体携带攻击:在反面图像生成中保留主题
articles.content_zh: 强烈的无限制的对抗性攻击可以扭曲一个形象的首要目标,以下称为主体. 为了在不损害攻击规模的前提下保持主题完整性,我们引入了载体:一个二级视觉元素,提供辅助区域,以在全球分级器指导下为攻击提供便利. 我们展示出三个主要结论: 1. 载体通过吸收全球常态攻击更新的更大份额来减少主题扭曲。 2. 载体可提高跨型可转让性,但以兼顾语义分离和转移性能的目标相关特性的强度为准。 3. 成功的定向攻击保留了个人化主体作为人类认为的主要内容,同时成功地误导了分类者。 我们的结果表明,视相二级载体为对抗性变化提供了辅助空间途径,在改进主题保护的同时,能够进行强大和可转移的攻击。

articles.title: BTC3D: Blended Tile Conditioning for Detail-Enhancing Image-to-3D Generation
articles.content: Recent diffusion-based pipelines have achieved promising progress in image-to-3D synthesis. However, generating high-fidelity details remains challenging, especially when the input image contains rich details. Existing approaches often rely on globally encoded conditioning features, which compress spatial information and limit the model to reproduce fine-grained details. This common design often leads to a phenomenon we term detail attenuation. Moreover, improving image-to-3D synthesis quality typically requires retraining or fine-tuning large diffusion models, which can be computationally expensive and impractical for complex 3D pipelines. In this work, we present Blended Tile Conditioning for image-to-3D generation (BTC3D), a training-free inference time framework that enhances fine-grained detail preservation in image-to-3D diffusion pipelines. To alleviate detail attenuation, we first examine the image feature additivity in image-to-3D models. Based on this property, we introduce a blended tile embedding that extracts local conditioning signals from split image regional patches, allowing the diffusion model to better preserve fine-grained visual details. To integrate the global and local conditioning guidance stably, we propose a dynamic conditioning schedule that gradually increases the influence of tile-level conditioning during later low-noise stages of diffusion. Our proposed method BTC3D operates entirely at inference time and can be seamlessly integrated into existing image-to-3D diffusion pipelines. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed approach significantly improves texture quality and visual fidelity of the base model while maintaining global structural consistency in a training-free manner.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: BTC3D: 详细增强图像至3D的混合图板条件 生成
articles.content_zh: 最近的以扩散为基础的管道在图像到3D合成方面取得了有希望的进展。 然而,生成高真实性的细节仍然具有挑战性,特别是当输入图像包含丰富的细节时. 现有方法往往依赖于全球编码的调节特征,这些特征压缩了空间信息,并限制了模型复制精细纹饰的细节. 这种共同的设计常常导致一种我们称之为细节衰减的现象. 此外,改进图像到-3D合成质量通常需要再培训或微调大型扩散模型,对于复杂的3D管来说,这些模型在计算上成本高昂,不切实际. 在这部作品中,我们提出了图像到3D生成(BTC3D)的Blended Tile Contition,这是一种无培训的推论时间框架,可以加强图像到3D扩散管中精细的分层细节保存. 为了缓解细节的减弱,我们首先审查图像到3D模型中的图像特征相加性. 基于这个属性,我们引入了混合瓦片嵌入法,从分割图像区域补丁中提取出局部的调节信号,使扩散模型能够更好地保存精细的视觉细节. 为了将全球和局部的调节导向稳定地整合起来,我们提出了一个动态调节时间表,在扩散的后期低噪音阶段,该时间表会逐渐地增加瓷砖级调节的影响力. 我们提出的BTC3D方法完全在推论时间运行,可以无缝地被整合到现有的图像到3D扩散管中. 实验结果表明,拟议办法大大提高了基本模型的纹理质量和视觉忠诚度,同时以无培训方式保持全球结构一致性。

articles.title: When Masking Helps or Hurts Robustness in Compressed CLIP: A Pre-Deployment Diagnostic
articles.content: This paper demonstrate that whether masking-based token pruning helps or hurts worst-group robustness can be predicted before deployment, without labels or fine-tuning. A systematic study of semantic masking across 8 spurious-correlation benchmarks shows its effect on worst-group accuracy is highly unstable: it improves accuracy by up to 82.5\% relative on some datasets and degrades it by up to 100\% on others. We trace this instability to spurious inversion: background patches receive higher CLIP text-similarity than the true object when the spurious attribute is background-separable, inverting the assumption every text- and attention-guided pruning method relies on. We introduce the Spurious Inversion Metric (SIM), a label-free, pre-deployment diagnostic whose sign predicts this effect with statistical significance (binomial $p=0.035$) across all 8 datasets, and remains dependable across 6 CLIP architectures with a clean foreground/background split. Naive masking is itself a major source of risk: it causes the largest average-accuracy loss of any method we evaluate, and its own per-image segmentation step is a significant runtime bottleneck. To address this, we design a batched, synchronization-free GPU segmentation routine that cuts this overhead from 3.5$\times$ to 1.75$\times$ baseline. Gating deployment by SIM's sign recovers masking's benefits while avoiding its worst failures, matching or exceeding a strong pruning baseline on 7 of 8 datasets.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 在压缩的 CLIP 中,
articles.content_zh: 本文表明,在部署之前,可以预测出以面具为基础的信使穿行是否有助于或会伤害最坏的组稳健性,而不需要标签或微调. 对8个假阴阳关系基准的语义遮掩的系统研究表明,其对最差组精度的影响非常不稳定:它在一些数据集上提高了82.5\%的相对精度,在另一些数据集上降低了100\%. 我们追踪这种不稳定性到虚假倒置:背景补丁得到的CLIP文本同义度高于假属性为背景相分离时的真实对象,颠倒每个文本和注意力相引导的穿插方法所依赖的假设. 我们引入了无标签的部署前诊断(SIM),其标志在所有8个数据集中以统计意义(binomial $p=0.035美元)预测这种效应,在6个CLIP架构中仍可依赖,前地和后地划分干净. 直觉口罩本身是主要的风险来源:它对我们评价的任何方法都造成了最大的平均准确性损失,它自己的逐象分解步骤是一个重要的跑步瓶颈. 为了解决这个问题,我们设计了一个批量的、无同步的GPU分块程序,将这一间接费用从3.5美元\times$减少到1.75美元\times$基线. 通过SIM的标志来进行部署可以恢复面具的好处,同时避免其最糟糕的失败,匹配或超过8个数据集中7个的强回流基线.

articles.title: ShieldCLIP: Selective Safety Alignment for Harmful Content Mitigation in Multimodal Foundation Models
articles.content: Multimodal encoders such as CLIP underlie many downstream systems, but their web-scale training data embed harmful associations that safety alignment must suppress without unnecessarily changing benign representations. Because ethical and practical constraints prevent collecting real unsafe content at scale, existing datasets pair safe real samples with generated counterparts, but label every generated sample unsafe, even when one modality is individually safe. To address this, we introduce ShieldCLIP, the first framework to condition safety alignment on the observed safety state of each modality rather than the origin of a sample, preserving safe content while redirecting only what is unsafe. We also introduce ViSUv2, a 195k-quadruplet dataset with independent per-modality safety labels across 578 concepts and 28 categories. Using these labels, ShieldCLIP defines a four-way conditional objective beyond pair-level supervision: safe content is anchored, unsafe modalities are redirected to their safe counterparts, mixed pairs update only the unsafe branch, and coherence is enforced when both are unsafe. We evaluate ShieldCLIP on cross-modal retrieval, text-to-image generation with Stable Diffusion v1.4 and SDXL, and image-to-text generation with LLaVA. Across these settings, ShieldCLIP consistently reduces harmful outputs over prior safety-aligned encoders and strong mitigation baselines, while preserving the utility of the original embedding space. Extensive ablation studies further show that both modality-specific supervision and the selective alignment objective contribute to these gains. Source code, trained models, and ViSUv2 (under a controlled-access protocol) will be made publicly available at https://aimagelab.github.io/ShieldCLIP/.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: ShieldCLIP:多式联运基础模型中有害内容缓解的选择性安全调整
articles.content_zh: CLIP等多式联运编码器是许多下游系统的基础,但其网络规模的培训数据嵌入了有害的关联,安全协调必须加以抑制,而不会不必要地改变良性表述。 由于道德和实际限制阻碍大规模收集真正的不安全内容,现有的数据集将安全真实的样本与生成的对应物相配,但给每个生成的样本贴上不安全的标签,即使一种模式是单独安全的。 为了解决这一问题,我们引入了ShieldCLIP,这是第一个将安全调整以每种模式的可观察到的安全状态作为条件的框架,而不是样本的来源,既保护安全内容,又只改变不安全的内容。 我们还引入了VisUv2,一个195k-quadruplet数据集,该数据集具有578个概念和28个类别的独立的通式安全标签. 使用这些标签,ShieldCLIP定义了一个超出对等级监督的四向条件目标:安全内容被锁定,不安全模式被重定向到安全对应方,混合配对只更新不安全分支,在两者都不安全时执行一致性. 我们评价了ShieldCLIP的跨模式检索,文本到图像生成与稳定分化v1.4和SDXL,图像到文本生成与LLaVA. 通过这些设置,ShieldCLIP在保持原始嵌入空间的效用的同时,始终比先前的安全相接编码器和强大的缓解基线减少有害的输出. 广泛的弃权研究进一步表明,特定模式的监督以及选择性的调整目标都有助于取得这些成果。 源代码、训练有素的模型和VISUv2(根据控制存取协议)将在https://aimagelab.github.io/ShieldCLIP/上公布。

articles.title: Unapologetically Distributed: A Call for Decentralized Document Analysis
articles.content: Privacy has become an increasingly important concern in the Document Analysis community, to the extent that in many environments such as archives, governmental institutions, and local businesses, the adoption of automation is restricted by legal and policy constraints. While federated learning has often been regarded as a ``necessary evil'', implying an unavoidable performance trade-off in exchange for decentralization and privacy, many prior works overlook its potential to improve robustness to out-of-distribution data. In this paper, we present Unapologetically Distributed, the first comprehensive study evaluating distributed learning in Document Analysis along three key axes simultaneously: the tasks addressed, the architectures employed, and the fine-tuning strategies applied. Specifically, we demonstrate how various distributed training approaches enhance generalization capabilities across diverse tasks such as Table Recognition, handwriting recognition, and Word Spotting, particularly during transfer learning stages. Our results provide strong evidence that decentralization is not merely a constraint, but a valuable opportunity to improve model robustness and adaptability in real-world Document Analysis scenarios.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 无法想象 分发:要求分散文件分析
articles.content_zh: 隐私已成为文件分析界日益重要的关切问题,因为在档案、政府机构和地方企业等许多环境中,自动化的采用受到法律和政策限制。 虽然联邦学习往往被视为一种“需要的罪恶”,这意味着不可避免的业绩取舍,以换取权力下放和隐私,但许多以前的工作忽略了提高分配外数据活力的潜力。 在本文中,我们介绍了Uniapologetical Discriptioned,这是第一次综合研究,评估文件分析中围绕三个关键轴线的分布式学习:所处理的任务、所采用的结构以及采用的微调战略。 具体而言,我们展示了各种分布式培训方法如何加强各种任务的通俗化能力,例如表识别、笔迹识别和Word Spotting,特别是在转移学习阶段。 我们的成果有力地证明,权力下放不仅是一种限制因素,而且是在现实世界文件分析设想中改进模式稳健性和适应性的宝贵机会。

articles.title: MC-PanDA++: Simpler, Stronger, and More Robust Domain-Adaptive Panoptic Segmentation
articles.content: Unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA) reduces the annotation burden in panoptic segmentation by leveraging a cost-effectively labeled source domain (e.g., synthetic) and an unlabeled target domain to bridge the distribution gap. Existing panoptic UDA methods rely on teacher-student consistency learning built upon suboptimal per-pixel segmentation architectures. In contrast, state-of-the-art mask transformers are rarely adopted due to their pronounced vulnerability to confirmation bias in consistency learning, where erroneous teacher predictions are reinforced during training. Our earlier approach, MC-PanDA, mitigates this issue through fine-grained confidence estimation, which suppresses gradients from unreliable masks while sampling informative yet reliable locations for loss computation. However, this method entails a complex multi-stage training and requires careful hyperparameter tuning. This work presents MC-PanDA++, which addresses these limitations by introducing: (i) self-supervised vision encoders that provide a stronger and more robust initialization, further reducing the reliance on human annotations, (ii) per-class, self-adapting mask-wide loss scaling that stabilizes training and enables the usage of a single set of hyperparameters across domains, and (iii) a single-stage training pipeline that decreases overall conceptual complexity. Together, these improvements result in a conceptually simpler, better-performing, and more robust method for domain-adaptive panoptics. Source code: https://github.com/martinovicivan/MC-PanDA
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: MC-PanDA++:更简单、更强和更坚固的域-辅助泛光分块
articles.content_zh: 无监督域适应(UDA)通过利用一个成本-效益高的被贴上标签的源域(如合成)和一个被贴上标签的目标域来弥补分布差距来减轻泛光分化中的注释负担. 现有的泛光学UDA方法依赖于师生之间基于每像素分解结构的次优化的一致学习. 相形之下,最先进的口罩变压器却很少被采用,因为它们在一致性学习中明显容易受到确认偏差的影响,在培训中教师的错误预测会得到加强. 我们早先采用的方法,即MC-PanDA,通过精细的信心估计减轻了这一问题,这种估计抑制了不可靠的口罩的梯度,同时为计算损失而取样信息丰富但可靠的地点。 然而,这种方法需要复杂的多阶段训练,需要小心的超参数调取. 这项工作提出了MC-PanDA++,通过引入以下方法来应对这些局限性:(一)自我监督的视觉编码器,提供更强大更强大的初始化,进一步减少对人说明的依赖;(二)每级自适应的口罩全宽损失缩放,稳定了培训,并使得能够跨领域使用一套单一的超参数;以及(三)降低整体概念复杂性的单相培训管道. 这些改进加在一起,形成了一种概念上简单,性能更好的更强的域适应光学方法. 资料来源:https://github.com/martinovicivan/MC-PanDA。

articles.title: Typographic Attack Against VLM-based AI-generated Image Detection
articles.content: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used for AI-generated image (AIGI) detection, providing natural-language explanations for authenticity judgments. However, their ability to interpret text within images may also expose these judgments to misleading semantic cues. We systematically evaluate typographic attack strategies across detection-oriented, open-weight, and commercial VLMs, considering both real-to-fake and fake-to-real attacks. Our results show that reasoning modes generally exhibit greater vulnerability than direct modes and that attack effectiveness exhibits pronounced directional asymmetry. Moreover, larger models tend to exhibit higher clean detection accuracy but also higher attack success rates. We further examine attack robustness under image and text transformations and investigate whether overlays indicating the correct class can aid error correction. Together, these analyses characterize how typographic attacks influence authenticity judgments and expose limitations of current VLM-based AIGI detection systems.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 基于 VLM 的 AI 生成图像检测
articles.content_zh: 视觉语言模型(VLMs)被越来越多地用于AI生成的图像(AIGI)检测,为真实判断提供了自然语言的解释. 然而,他们在图像中解释文本的能力也可能使这些判断暴露出误导的语义提示. 我们系统地评估各种面向检测、公开重量和商业的VLM的打字攻击战略,同时考虑真假和假假攻击。 我们的结果表明,推理模式通常比直接模式更加脆弱,而且攻击效果显示出明显的方向不对称。 此外,较大的模型往往显示出较高的清洁探测精度,但也显示出较高的攻击成功率。 我们进一步审查在图像和文本转换下的攻击强度,并调查显示正确等级的重叠是否有助于修正错误。 这些分析共同说明了打字攻击如何影响真实性的判断,并揭露了目前基于甚高频的AIGI检测系统的局限性。

articles.title: BAM! Bayesian Anything Model: a foundation model for generative computational imaging
articles.content: Generative models are transforming Bayesian computational imaging, yet the field still lacks physics-aware foundation models. Current practice falls into two camps. Large foundation image models are deployed as plug-and-play priors with zero-shot approximate likelihood guidance, which introduces significant bias and computational cost. Physics-aware generative models avoid this bias, but each is tied to a specific dataset, task and instrument. We introduce BAM (Bayesian Anything Model), a lightweight foundation model for few-step, physics-aware posterior sampling that generalises robustly to unseen data and tasks, zero-shot or with minimal finetuning. BAM upgrades the operator-conditioned Reconstruct Anything Model (RAM) backbone (Terris et al.) into a conditional flow map, so instrument physics is specified at inference time rather than fixed during training. BAM has just 36M parameters and is pre-trained jointly on large image corpora and libraries of forward operators. A single network then draws posterior samples in a few steps, with no likelihood approximation and no guidance weights to tune. Across linear inverse problems on FFHQ, AFHQ, LSUN, DIV2K and the Kohler camera-shake benchmark, BAM outperforms in just 3 steps both specialised models and leading zero-shot methods in sample quality, at a fraction of their computational cost. BAM gives the community an accessible entry point to generative computational imaging, lowers the economic and environmental cost of training imaging models, and opens a new path for research on physics-aware Bayesian computational imaging. Official page: https://bayesian-anything-model.github.io/
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 巴姆! 贝叶斯语Name Anything Model:基因计算成像的基础模型
articles.content_zh: 基因模型正在转化出贝叶斯计算成像,然而这个领域仍然缺乏物理学认识的基础模型. 目前的做法分为两个营地。 大型地基图像模型被作为插头和游戏前传被部署,并带有零镜头相近概率指导,这引入了显著的偏差和计算成本. 物理意识遗传模型避免了这种偏差,但每个模型都与特定的数据集,任务和仪器相接. 我们引入了BAM(Bayesian Anything Model),这是一种轻量级的基础模型,用于几步,有物理学意识的后台采样,这种采样能普遍地对隐形数据和任务,零发或微调最小. BAM将操作员有条件的"Anything Model"(RAM)主干线(Terris等)升级为有条件的流图,因此仪器物理是在推断时指定的,而不是在训练时固定. BAM只有36M参数,在大型图像公司和前方操作员的库上联合进行预训. 然后,一个单一的网络在几个步骤中绘制出后遗症样本,没有可能的近似和引导重来调谐. 纵观FFHQ、AFHQ、LSUN、DIV2K和Kohler相机震动基准的线性反向问题,BAM在专门模型和引领样本质量的零射法方面都仅以三个步骤超过,其计算成本仅为一小部分。 BAM为社区提供了一个可进入的基因计算成像的切入点,降低了培训成像模型的经济和环境成本,并开辟了研究物理学认识的巴耶斯计算成像的新路径. 官方页面:https://bayesian-Anything-model.github.io/ (原始内容存档于2018-09-22).

articles.title: Diffusable Latents from Structure-Agnostic Distillation
articles.content: Distilling pretrained foundation models into an autoencoder bottleneck improves latent diffusability, enabling diffusion models to converge faster and reach higher sample quality. Standard distillation aligns the latent at each position to a co-located teacher feature, tying the latent layout to the teacher's. We show this constraint is unnecessary: aligning a single pooled image-level descriptor to the teacher's performs as well as or slightly better than dense position-wise distillation. We compare first-order and relational pooled objectives across latent shapes and teacher modalities. First-order matching extends naturally to 1D token-sequence latents and across modalities, where distilling a text encoder into an image autoencoder still improves diffusability; a relational objective based only on each image's nearest neighbours improves it as well. Code and blog post are available at https://github.com/AdrienRR/structure-agnostic-distillation and https://kyutai.org/blog/2026-09-28-structure-agnostic-distillation/.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 结构不可知的分解缓冲
articles.content_zh: 将预先训练的地基模型分解成自动编码瓶颈可提高潜在可扩散性,使扩散模型能更快地汇合并达到更高的样本质量。 标准蒸馏法将每个位置的潜入与同一位置的教师特征相配合,将潜入的布局与教师的布局相接. 我们显示这种限制是不必要的:将单一集合的图像级别描述符与教师的表演以及或稍好于密集的姿势分馏。 我们比较各种潜在形态和教师模式的第一顺序和关联集合目标。 第一顺序匹配自然延伸至 1D 符号序列潜伏和跨模式,其中将文本编码器分馏为图像自定义编码器仍然能提高可扩散性;仅基于每个图像近邻的关系目标也会改善. 代码和博客贴文见https://github.com/AdrienRR/structure-agnostic-distillation和https://kyutai.org/blog/2026-09-28-structure-agnostic-distillation/。

articles.title: FANVIDv2: Evaluating Video Super-Resolution by Face and Licence-Plate Recognition Under Compound Degradation
articles.content: Video super-resolution (VSR) is normally judged by PSNR and SSIM on clips that were downsampled bicubically, although in surveillance its purpose is to make faces and licence plates \emph{recognisable}. We present FANVIDv2, a benchmark that scores VSR by what a recognition pipeline can do with its output. FANVIDv2 provides $320\times180$ low-resolution (LR) clips with high-resolution (HR) references for 48 public figures (with one HR gallery image each) and 375 licence-plate clips covering 360 distinct plate strings. LR clips are generated with a randomised compound degradation (blur, resize jitter, sensor noise, JPEG compression, final downsampling) rather than bicubic downsampling alone. Two metrics score recognition \emph{inside} detections: FaceRecBox rewards a face only if it is localised and correctly identified, and TextRecBox scores plate transcriptions by normalised edit distance weighted by localisation quality. With a 2.3\,M-parameter VSR baseline (RCDM), FaceRecBox rises from 0.6864 to 0.7222, identity accuracy on matched faces from 84.35\% to 86.93\%, and TextRecBox from 0.3088 to 0.3667; a residual-map gated variant (RCDM-RMGF) reaches 0.3801 on plates. We describe the degradation model, the baseline architectures and the scorers in detail, and release annotations, metadata, download and degradation scripts and evaluation code.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: FANVIDv2:通过面部和许可证-复合降解下的板块识别评估视频超分辨率
articles.content_zh: 视频超解析(VSR)通常由PSNR和SSIM在被下取样的短片上进行判断,虽然在监视中其目的是制作相貌和牌照\emph{识别}. 我们给出了FANVIDv2,这个基准根据一个识别管道对它的输出能有什么作用来评分VSR. FANVIDv2为48名公众人物提供了320\times180美元高分辨率参考(HR)的低分辨(LR)片段(每个带一幅HR画廊图像)和375个许可证牌片段,覆盖了360个有区别的板块串. LR片段由随机分解的化合物降解(blur,再大小的jitter,传感器噪声,JPEG压缩,最终下采样)生成,而不是单由双子下采样. 两个度量衡的分数识别\emph{inside} 检测: FaceRecBox 只有在一个面被定位和正确识别的情况下才会奖励一个面被,而TextRecBox 的分数分数则通过正常的编辑距离按本地化质量加权来计算. 用2.3\,M-参数VSR基线(RCDM),FaceRecBox从0.6864升至0.7222,相配面上的身份精度从84.35\%到86.93\%;TextRecBox从0.3088升至0.3667;一个残相图入门变体(RCDM-RMGF)在板上达到0.3801. 我们详细描述了退化模型、基线架构和计分器,并发布了说明、元数据、下载和退化脚本和评价代码。

articles.title: From Modes to Memories: Characterizing the Scale-Space Dynamics of Diffusion Models
articles.content: Diffusion models are typically viewed as stochastic processes that transform noise into data. We take a complementary perspective: a diffusion model defines a family of deterministic dynamical systems indexed by noise scale. At each fixed scale $σ$, we treat the denoiser as a self-map and study its dynamics. For an exact denoiser, fixed points correspond to critical points of the smoothed data density, while attractors correspond to its modes; as $σ$ increases, sample-level modes merge into progressively coarser ones. This suggests a geometric view of memorization: examples that receive excess probability mass due to duplication or overfitting, as well as outliers, should remain distinguishable under stronger smoothing than ordinary examples. We quantify this persistence by the critical scale $σ_c$, the largest noise scale at which an example is retained by the fixed-scale dynamics. In conditional models, the same construction extends naturally to image--caption pairs. Experiments in controlled settings and on large-scale models show that $σ_c$ tracks memorization arising from duplication, overfitting, and outliers, and identifies both memorized and partially memorized examples in Stable Diffusion. Moreover, $σ_c$ yields interpretable measures of the image spatial distribution and caption dependence of memorization.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 从模式到记忆:描述扩散模型的尺度-空间动态
articles.content_zh: 扩散模型一般被视为将噪声转化为数据的有花样的过程. 我们从互补的角度:扩散模型定义了由噪声尺度索引的决定性动态系统家族. 在每一个固定的比额表上, 美元,我们把denoiser 当作一个自我图 并研究它的动态。 对于一个精确的denoiser,固定点与平滑数据密度的关键点相对应,而吸引点则与其模式相对应;随着$相加,样本级模式会合并为逐渐收缩的. 这表明了记忆的几何视角:由于重复或过度适应而获得过大概率质量的例子,以及外观,在比普通例子更能平滑的情况下,仍应保持可分. 我们用临界尺度($-c$)来量化这种持久性,这是固定尺度动力学保留一个实例的最大噪音尺度。 在有条件的模型中,同一种构造自然地延伸至图像-封装对. 在受控环境和大规模模型上的实验表明,由于重复、过度适应和外延而导致的($-C$)跟踪记忆,并在 " 稳定扩散 " 中识别出被记忆和部分被记忆的实例。 此外,美元得出可解释的图像空间分布量和记忆的字幕依赖度。

articles.title: SAGE: Salient Factor Discovery and Generation with Visual Foundation Representations
articles.content: Given a target dataset, such as faces with eyeglasses, and a background dataset, such as faces without, contrastive analysis separates \textit{salient} factors specific to the target from \textit{common} content shared by both. We aim for salient representations that capture target-specific detail in each image, such as the shape, color, and position of the glasses, so that they reveal subtypes without subtype labels and guide the generation of new examples of a discovered subtype, even one with no name or text description. We introduce SAGE, which learns both factors directly in the high-dimensional spatial latent of a frozen representation autoencoder and conditions a diffusion transformer on the learned salient representation of a reference image. On Digits-ImageNet and FFHQ eyeglasses, SAGE combines high-fidelity \textit{reconstruction} (rFID below $2$) with unsupervised \textit{subtype discovery}, recovering the digits better than baselines (probe accuracy $0.950$ vs.\ at most $0.281$) and revealing eyewear types, finer sunglasses styles, and mislabeled images; salient-conditioned \textit{generation} raises Digits-ImageNet subtype accuracy over the unfactorized latent ($90.5\%$ vs.\ $27.7\%$) and diversity on both datasets. On retinal OCT, SAGE's salient space separates three diseases using only normal/disease labels.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: SAGE:具有视觉基金会代表性的突出因素发现和生成
articles.content_zh: 鉴于一个目标数据集,例如有眼镜的面相,以及一个背景数据集,例如没有面相,对比分析将\textit{salient}目标特有的因素与\textit{common}双方共享的内容相分离. 我们的目标是能捕捉到每个图像中特定目标细节的显著表现,如眼镜的形状,颜色,和位置等,这样可以揭示没有子类型标签的子类型,并引导被发现子类型的新实例的生成,即使是没有名字或文字描述的子类型. 我们引入SAGE,它直接从被冻结的表示自编码器的高维空间潜伏中学习出两个因素,同时将传播变压器作为参考图像所学到的显著表现条件。 在 Digits-ImageNet 和 FFHQ 眼镜上,SAGE 将高纯度\textit{reconstruction}(rFID 低于2美元)与未监管的\textit{子类型发现}结合起来,恢复比基线更好的数字(精确度为 9.50美元=\,最高为0.281美元),并揭示出眼衣类型、更细的太阳镜样式和被贴上错误标签的图像; 显著的有条件的\textit{世代} 提高了Digits-ImageNet 子类型相对于未设定参数的潜伏(90.5美元=\27.7美元)和两个数据集的多样性。 在视网膜OCT上,SAGE的显著空间只使用正常/疾病标签区分出三种疾病.

articles.title: Introduction to Computer Vision
articles.content: This book presents a code-first introduction to computer vision, spanning classical 2D image processing, classical 3D vision, and deep learning. Organized as 44 short chapters across three parts, the book builds each topic from first principles: image arithmetic and morphology; convolution, pyramids, and frequency-domain filtering; feature detection, optical flow, and stereo; projective geometry, camera calibration, and structure from motion; and the full arc of modern deep learning, from a single neuron through convolutional networks, backpropagation, classic architectures, transfer learning, object detection, and semantic and instance segmentation, concluding with engineering considerations like mixed-precision and parallel training. Every technique is implemented directly in Python and NumPy or PyTorch and checked numerically against the corresponding OpenCV or PyTorch library function, so readers see not just the mathematics but its concrete behavior on real and synthetic data. The material was distilled with AI assistance from freely available online course notes, condensing extensive working code into concise mathematical exposition while preserving verified, reproducible results throughout. It is intended as a self-contained reference for students and practitioners who want to understand computer vision algorithms and their Python implementations.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 计算机视野介绍
articles.content_zh: 这本书提出了计算机视觉的代码第一入门,跨越了古典二维图像处理,古典三维视觉,并深入学习. 该书分为44个短篇,分三部分,从第一原理构建出每个主题:图像算术和形态;演化、金字塔和频率域过滤;特征检测、光学流和立体;投影几何、相机校正和从运动起的结构;现代深层学习的全弧,从一个神经元到进化网络、回向传播、经典建筑、转移学习、物体检测、语义和实例分解,最后提出了混合精度和平行训练等工程考虑。 每个技术都直接由Python和NumPy或PyTorch执行,并对照相应的OpenCV或PyTorch库函数进行数字检查,因此读者不仅看到数学,还看到其在真实和合成数据上的具体行为. 该材料在大赦国际的协助下从可自由获取的在线课程说明中提炼出,将广泛的工作代码压缩为简明的数学演示,同时在整个过程中保留经核实的可复制的成果。 它的用意是作为想理解计算机视觉算法及其Python实施的学生和从业人员的自成一体的参考.

articles.title: D-Scope: Decomposing and Steering Diffusion Transformers with Sparse Autoencoders
articles.content: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) reveal visual structure in diffusion transformers (DiTs), but interpreting a feature does not establish whether it can be used to control generation. We introduce D-Scope (Diffusion Scope), a framework that connects feature interpretation to generation control through shared visual evidence. D-Scope aggregates SigLIP~2 embeddings of highly activating image patches into visual centroids. Matching target text descriptions against these visual centroids in the shared image-text embedding space then enables retrieval of individual features without per-feature text annotations. The underlying patches provide evidence for inspecting each selection, while spatially masked interventions test the corresponding decoder direction at varying strengths under fixed generation conditions. We characterize 150 SAEs across two model families and five layers, and introduce a benchmark of 100 target concepts with ten contexts each spanning under-specified and explicit-conflict conditions. Our empirical results show that high reconstruction fidelity can coexist with low dictionary utilization and limited visual-evidence coverage. Under per-case best-of-sweep strength selection, contrastive retrieval yields larger mean regional SigLIP~2 gains than direct retrieval across the tested steering configurations, without consistently improving outside-region preservation. D-Scope provides an inspectable framework for evaluating sparse DiT features through their visual evidence and the effects of their decoder directions on generation. The demo is available at https://jiahaozhang-public.github.io/d-scope/.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: D- Scope: 以 Sparse 自动编码器分解并引导扩散变形器
articles.content_zh: Sparse自编码器(SAEs)在扩散变压器(DiTs)中揭示出视觉结构,但解释一个特性并不能确定它是否可用于控制生成. 我们引入了D-Scope(Difmusion Specide),这个框架通过共享的视觉证据将特征解释与生成控制联系起来. D-Scope聚合SigLIP~2将高活性图像补丁嵌入到可视化中间体. 在共享的图像-文本嵌入空间中将目标文字描述与这些可视化的中间机器人相匹配,然后就可以在没有每个地物文字说明的情况下检索个人特征. 基础补丁为检查每个选择提供了证据,而空间遮蔽干预则在固定生成条件下以不同强度测试相应的解码器方向. 我们把150个SAE描述为两个模范家庭和五个层次,并采用100个目标概念的基准,每个目标概念有10个背景,涵盖不明确和明确的冲突局势。 我们的经验结果显示,高度的重建忠诚可以与字典利用率低和视觉证据覆盖面有限共存。 在每例最优的抽取强度选择下,对比性取取回在区域SigLIP~2的平均值收益大于经过测试的指向配置的直接取回,而没有持续地改善区域外的保存. D-Scope提供了一个可检查的框架,通过视觉证据及其解码器方向对生成的影响来评价稀有的DiT特性. 该演示可在https://jiahaozhang-public.github.io/d-scope/上查阅。

articles.title: ExpandDiff: Dynamic Range Expanding Diffusion for Single-Image HDR Reconstruction
articles.content: Single-image HDR reconstruction requires inferring missing detail while preserving the visible content of an LDR image. Differences in sensor dynamic range and exposure cause LDR images to lose varying amounts of information in shadows and highlights. We present ExpandDiff, a conditional diffusion pipeline that jointly reconstructs clipped shadows and highlights. To account for this variation, we introduce Dynamic Clipping Synthesis (DCS), which randomly samples shadow and highlight clipping percentiles when constructing training inputs from HDR targets. A pixel-space diffusion model guided by spatially-adaptive normalization then predicts perceptually encoded HDR through a bounded output head, reconstructing both clipping directions in one sampling trajectory. On the SI-HDR benchmark, ExpandDiff variants improve HDR reconstruction accuracy by 3.43 dB in PU21-PSNR over the strongest evaluated competing method, and by 7.34 dB under two-sided clipping. The code and supplementary material are available at https://memreandiran.github.io/expanddiff/.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 扩展Diff:用于单图像 HDR重建的动态范围扩展
articles.content_zh: 单一图像的HDR重建需要推断出缺失的细节,同时保留一个LDR图像的可见内容. 传感器动态范围的差异和曝光导致LDR图像在阴影和亮点中丢失了不同数量的信息. 我们提出扩展Diff, 一个有条件的传播管道 联合重建剪接的阴影和亮点。 为了解释这一变化,我们引入了动态剪接合成(DCS),在构建来自人类发展报告目标的培训投入时随机抽取阴影并突出剪切百分位数。 一个以空间适应性正常化为指导的像素-空间扩散模型,然后通过一个有界输出头来预测对HDR的感知编码,在一个取样轨迹中重建两个剪接方向. 在SI-HDR基准上,扩展Diff变体提高了PU21-PSNR中的3.43 dB的HDR重建精度,超过了最强的评价相竞方法,在双侧剪接下提高了7.34 dB. 守则和补充材料见https://memerandiran.github.io/expanddiff/。

articles.title: Semantic Watermarking for Malicious Image Manipulation Detection
articles.content: The proliferation of high-fidelity generative editing models has made it possible to inject violent or sexual content into otherwise ordinary images while preserving visual plausibility, with concrete consequences for public discourse and vulnerable populations. We propose a robust semantic watermarking framework that reframes the watermark as a recoverable semantic reference rather than an opaque identifier. Our framework combines a $β$-VAE-based binary watermark (CLIP-VAE) with explicit channel-aware training---random bit-flip noise is injected during training so that the decoder learns graceful degradation under the noisy watermarking channel. As a downstream application, a lightweight module SDA-Net uses the recovered semantic embedding to expose not only whether but in which semantic direction an image has been altered. In a 5-way comparison against representative binary hashing baselines (SimHash, ITQ, HashNet, and their robust-MLP variants), CLIP-VAE achieves the highest reconstruction cosine similarity to the original CLIP embedding under realistic InstructPix2Pix bit-error rates, and uniquely supports direction-of-drift detection---a forensic complement to existing content-moderation pipelines.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 恶意图像操纵水印检测
articles.content_zh: 高忠诚度基因编辑模型的普及使得有可能在保持视觉可信度的同时,将暴力或性内容注入其他普通图像,对公共言论和弱势群体产生具体的后果。 我们建议建立一个强有力的语义水标记框架,将水标记重新设定为可恢复的语义参考,而不是不透明的标识。 我们的框架将基于 β$-VAE 的 二进制水印(CLIP-VAE) 与明确的通道感知训练相融合,在训练中注入随机比特-flip噪声,使解码器在吵闹的水印道下学习优雅的降解. 作为下游应用,一个轻量级模块SDA-Net使用被回收的语义嵌入,不仅暴露出一个图像是否被改变,而且改变在哪个语义方向. 在与具有代表性的二元散列基线(SimHash,ITQ,HashNet,及其强力-MLP变体)的5道比较中,CLIP-VAE实现了与原CLIP嵌入在现实的InstructPix2Pix比特-error速率下的最高相近的重建相干性,并独一无二地支持了驱动检测方向--一个对现有内容-调制管的法证补充.

articles.title: FOMO: Forget the Concept, Don't Miss Out on the Scene in Selective Video Unlearning
articles.content:
The rapid advancement of generative video models has enabled the synthesis of increasingly realistic and temporally coherent videos, while also raising concerns about the generation of harmful content. The reliance on large-scale web datasets during training inevitably exposes these models to undesirable material, making concept unlearning an essential mitigation. Existing methods mainly target static visual concepts, such as objects, identities, or unsafe appearance, largely overlooking motion unlearning. Furthermore, these approaches often pay little attention to preserving the surrounding scene. As a result, successful concept removal may unintentionally alter the background, composition, or overall video dynamics. We argue that effective unlearning should ideally change only what is targeted, while minimizing unnecessary changes to the remaining scene. In this work, we introduce FOMO, to the best of our knowledge the first training-based selective video unlearning method that directly treats preservation of the original scene as a priority. We formulate unlearning around two complementary objectives: what to change and what to preserve. Our method localizes concept-related representations and modifies them, while the preservation mechanism maintains non-target scene information without requiring auxiliary data. Beyond simply erasing unwanted concepts, FOMO explicitly redirects the generation toward a specified safe alternative. We further extend this formulation to motion unlearning, where the concept is defined by temporal behavior rather than a fixed spatial region. Our solution achieves effective unlearning across unsafe content, object, and motion concepts, while achieving the best trade-off between concept removal and scene preservation.
  Code: https://github.com/gmum/FOMO
  Project Page https://gmum.github.io/FOMO
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 忘记概念,不要错过 在选取视频的场景中出道
articles.content_zh:
基因视频模型的迅速发展,使得越来越现实和时间上一致的视频得以合成,同时也引起人们对产生有害内容的关切. 在培训期间对大规模网络数据集的依赖不可避免地使这些模型暴露在不良材料中,从而使概念不学习成为必要的缓解。 现有方法主要针对静态视觉概念,如物体,身份等,或不安全外观,基本上俯瞰运动而无所学. 此外,这些办法往往很少注意保护周围的场景。 因此,成功删除概念可能会无意地改变背景、组成或整体视频动态。 我们认为,有效的不学习最好只改变目标,同时尽量减少对所剩场面的不必要的改变。 在这部作品中,我们向FOMO介绍,就我们所知,第一个基于训练的有选择的视频不学习方法,直接将保护原场景作为一个优先事项. 我们围绕着两个相辅相成的目标:改变什么和保留什么。 我们的方法将与概念相关的表达方式本地化并修改,而保存机制维持非目标场景信息而不需要辅助数据. 除了简单地去除不想要的概念外,FOMO还明确将这一代人转向特定的安全选择。 我们进一步将这种提法扩展到不学习运动,即概念由时间行为而不是固定的空间区域界定。 我们的解决方案能够有效地从不安全的内容、对象和运动概念中吸取知识,同时在概念去除和现场保护之间实现最佳的取舍。
代码:https://github.com/gmum/FOMO
项目页 https://gmum.github.io/FOMO (英语).

articles.title: GroundingPI: A Grounding Foundation Model towards Physical Intelligence with Visual Primitives
articles.content: Precise grounding matters. It specifies which object is the target and where that object is, even in clutter and for tiny objects, and it has to be fast enough for closed-loop control. Yet vision-language-action (VLA) and world-action models (WAMs) take perception from general-purpose vision-language and video-generation backbones, which still fail in these settings. We introduce GroundingPI, a 4B grounding foundation model that generates points and boxes as quantized coordinates in a shared vocabulary. Training combines multimodal and spatial pretraining, supervised fine-tuning, and reinforcement learning with GRPO, using supervision from public datasets and dedicated data engines. Against 44 baselines across 34 grounding benchmarks spanning 11 perceptual capabilities, GroundingPI establishes a new state of the art, averaging 73.68%, above the larger GPT-6 Astra (71.54%). As a downstream visual backbone, GroundingPI improves performance on robotic manipulation and autonomous driving. On RoboTwin 2.0, it outperforms every mainstream backbone we evaluate in all four out-of-distribution settings, by up to 24.8% relative to the strongest backbone. On RoboCasa-GR1, GroundingPI trained with 50% of the demonstrations outperforms those baselines trained with 75%. On nuScenes, used as the visual backbone, GroundingPI attains an average open-loop L2 error of 0.296 m. We systematically analyze GroundingPI's pretraining in scale and data composition. Downstream autonomous driving and robotic manipulation improve as the pretraining is scaled. Analyzing the data recipe across these 11 perceptual capabilities shows dense grounding's substantial benefits for both, and OCR's potential as a catalyst for perceptual learning. These results support grounding as a perceptual foundation, and dedicated perceptual pretraining as a promising direction for foundation models of physical intelligence.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: GroundingPI:向视觉原生体提供物理情报的地基基础模型
articles.content_zh: 精入地为事. 它指定了哪个物体是目标,以及该物体的位置,即使是在杂乱无章地和对于小物体来说,它必须足够快地进行闭路控制. 然而,视觉-语言行动(VLA)和世界行动模式(WAMS)从通用视觉-语言和视频生成的骨干中吸取了感知力,而这些在这样的环境下仍然失败. 我们引入了地平线(GroundingPI),一个4B地平线地平线模型,它生成点和框作为共享词汇中被量化的坐标. 培训将多式联运和空间预训、监督微调和强化学习与GRPO相结合,利用公共数据集和专用数据引擎的监督。 根据34个地面基准的44个基线,地面测量指数跨越了11个认知能力,确定了新的技术水平,平均为73.68%,高于较大的GPT-6 Astra(71.54%)。 作为下游视觉骨干,地平线PI改进了机器人操纵和自主驾驶的性能. 在RoboTwin 2.0上,它比我们评价的每一个主流骨干在全部四个分配外的设置中的表现要好,相对于最强的骨干而言,最高达24.8%. 在RoboCasa-GR1上,地面测量项目培训50%的示威表现超过了75%的培训基线。 在被作为视觉主干线的nuScenes上,地平线PI平均得到0.296米的开口L2出错. 我们系统地分析地平线PI在规模和数据构成方面的预训. 随着预训规模的扩大,下游自主驾驶和机器人操纵得到了改进. 分析这11种感知能力的数据配方显示,密集地面对两者都具有巨大的好处,OCR作为感知学习的催化剂的潜力。 这些结果支持将认知基础作为基础,并将专门的认知先入为主的培训作为身体智能基础模型的有希望的方向。

articles.title: GroundAnything: Reconciling Parallel Decoding with Precise Visual Grounding at Flash Speed
articles.content: Autoregressive (AR) grounding models serialize spatial predictions, introducing sequential latency and imposing a causal order on output tokens. We view grounding as visual evidence extraction: objects, locations, and spatial relations are jointly constrained by the image and query, yet their dependencies do not imply an intrinsic left-to-right generation order. This distinction makes bidirectional diffusion a natural fit, allowing spatial hypotheses to emerge in parallel and be jointly refined through iterative denoising. We introduce GroundAnything, a 4B-parameter grounding foundation model that reconciles fast parallel decoding with precise localization through blockwise denoising. Training combines grounding pretraining from public datasets and dedicated data engines, direct AR-to-diffusion conversion with joint AR and diffusion objectives, supervised fine-tuning, and GRPO-based reinforcement post-training. Across 30 grounding benchmarks, our autoregressive variant, GroundAnything-VLM, establishes a new overall state of the art among similarly sized models at 72.42%, remaining competitive with GPT-6 Astra (71.35%). With entropy-guided decoding, GroundAnything also surpasses the prior state of the art at this scale, averaging 61.75% versus 53.32% for the fast MTP-based LocateAnything model. We further explore decoding strategies, showing that an optional self-speculative mode achieves a $4.51\times$ speedup over the AR counterpart with a 0.74 percentage-point drop in COCO F1mIoU. Infrastructure experiments show that progressive inference optimizations translate parallel decoding into practical speedups. These support efficient visual grounding in latency-sensitive real-world systems.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 任何东西: 与精准的视觉定位同步解码
articles.content_zh: 自动回转(AR)地基模型将空间预测序列化,引入相继延后并给输出符设置了因果顺序. 我们视地为视觉证据提取:物体、位置和空间关系受到图像和查询的共同制约,但其依赖性并不意味着内在的从左到右生成顺序。 这种区分使得双向传播是一种自然的相合性,使得空间假说能够平行地出现,并通过迭代去名来被联合完善. 我们引入了地平线,一种4B参数地平线基模型,通过阻断来调和快平行解码和精确的局部化. 培训将公共数据集和专用数据引擎的地面预训、直接AR-向扩散转换与AR和传播联合目标、监督微调和基于GRPO的强化培训相结合。 在30个基准基准中,我们的自旋变体,即地平线-甚高频(Ground Anything-VLM),在类似大小的模型中确立了新的总体技术水平,达到72.42%,与GPT-6 Astra(71.35%)保持竞争力。 以 Entropy 制导的解码,Ground Anything 也超过了这个尺度上之前的状态,对于快速基于 MTP 的 Lace Anything 模型来说,平均为 61.75%,而53.32%. 我们进一步探索解码策略,显示可选自猜模式比AR对应方实现4.51\times美元加速,COCO F1mIOU下降0.74个百分点. 基础设施实验显示,渐进推论优化将并行解码转化为实用加速. 这些支持在对耐久性敏感的现实世界系统中高效的视觉定位。

articles.title: Structural Limits of the Information-Theoretic Uncertainty Decomposition
articles.content: Uncertainty estimation in machine learning typically decomposes uncertainty into aleatoric uncertainty (AU) and epistemic uncertainty (EU) using the standard information-theoretic framework. However, in practice, two critical issues arise: entanglement (AU and EU are highly correlated) and epistemic collapse (EU magnitude shrinks with increasing model capacity). We analyze this framework on a functional level and discover that significant portions of the assumed AU, EU range are infeasible in finite settings, and cannot be attained with any class probabilities. We characterize how this infeasible region scales with the number of classes and Monte Carlo samples $N$ (e.g., from ensembles with $N$ members), revealing it is bounded by $\text{AU} \leq \log(2)/N$. Crucially, the infeasible region's boundary helps explain epistemic collapse: when model confidence is high, $\text{AU} > \text{EU}$ is guaranteed by this fundamental structural limitation. Our findings show that increasing ensemble size mitigates epistemic collapse by reducing the infeasible area. Lastly, we caution against interpreting AU and EU as independent quantities in low AU regimes, since we show they are coupled when $\text{AU} \leq \log(2)/N$.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 信息理论不确定性分解的结构限制
articles.content_zh: 机器学习中的不确定性估计通常会利用标准的信息-理论框架将不确定性分解为厌倦不确定性(AU)和感知不确定性(EU). 然而,在实践中,出现了两个关键问题:缠绕(非盟和欧盟是高度相联的)和感官崩溃(欧盟的规模随着模型能力的提高而收缩). 我们从功能层面分析这一框架,发现假定的非盟、欧盟范围中有相当一部分在有限的环境下不可行,无法以任何类概率实现。 我们描述这个不可行的区域如何以班级数目和蒙特卡洛抽样美元(例如,从有美元会员的综艺节目中抽样)来衡量,揭示它以$\text{AU}\leq\log(2)/N$为界。 关键是,不可行的区域边界有助于解释感官崩溃:当模型置信度高时,$\text{AU} >\text{EU}美元受到这一基本结构限制的保障。 我们的研究结果表明,日益扩大的综艺体积通过减少不可行的面积来缓解癫痫崩溃。 最后,我们告诫不要将非盟和欧盟解释为非盟低层政权中的独立数量,因为我们显示,当$\text{AU}\leq\log(2)/N$时,它们是相配的。

articles.title: SPOON: Towards Coherent Compositional 3D Scene Generation from Uncalibrated Multi-view Images
articles.content: Compositional 3D scene generation aims to recover complete 3D object shapes and their spatial arrangement from visual observations. Recent image-conditioned 3D generators provide strong priors for producing high-quality object geometry, making the generation of complex scenes increasingly practical. A central challenge is therefore to spatially organize these generated assets into a globally coherent scene while remaining consistent with multi-view observations. Existing approaches either entangle scene layout with object generation or separately estimate spatial placement from view-specific observations, where pose hypotheses may remain ambiguous and inconsistent across views, often resulting in an incoherent object-camera soup. We introduce SPOON, a framework that reformulates multi-view compositional 3D generation as scene-level, geometry-grounded pose reasoning. Rather than treating view-specific object pose hypotheses independently, SPOON coordinates them using reconstruction-derived multi-view geometry through a Guide-Route-Reconcile paradigm. This progressively organizes object poses and camera configurations into a coherent scene-level spatial arrangement. Extensive experiments on ARSG-110K and MIDI-3D-Front demonstrate consistent improvements in object placement and scene composition across varying numbers of input views. On ARSG-110K, SPOON reduces scene-level and object-level Chamfer distances by 12.7% and 17.7%, respectively, compared with a strong baseline.
